## 2026-05-19 - [CSS Injection in Chart Component]
**Vulnerability:** The `ChartStyle` component in `src/components/ui/chart.tsx` was injecting a `<style>` block using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with unsanitized props (`id`, config keys, and color values), allowing for CSS injection or potentially breaking out of the `<style>` tag.
**Learning:** Even internal UI components generated by tools (like shadcn/ui) can contain potential injection points when using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` for dynamic styling. Sanitization must be applied to both property names (CSS variables) and values.
**Prevention:** Always sanitize any dynamic content passed to `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Use whitelist regex for identifiers and strip dangerous characters (`; { } \ < >`) from values. Use quoted attribute selectors to prevent selector-level breakouts.
